Bird flu spreads across Australia, over 100 cases confirmed

The H5N1 strain of bird flu has been confirmed in over one hundred cases across Australia. Authorities in Victoria are preparing for potential outbreaks, with the sky identified as a significant threat vector. The spread affects wild bird populations, with concerns that thousands may die, similar to past events in the United Kingdom. Public awareness campaigns are underway to inform citizens about the virus's transmission and necessary precautions.
